source: Work out the ones, then the tens. If a sum is more than 10, carry over. If you cannot subtract, regroup (borrow).
reason: Carrying applies when sum is 10 or more, not only more than 10.

source: For area, integrate $|f(x)|$. Split off the parts of the graph below the $x$-axis, and between two curves integrate (upper)−(lower). Integrating velocity gives the distance travelled.
reason: Integral of signed velocity is displacement; distance requires integral of speed/absolute velocity.
